thesis: Third hold in a row, and I want to justify it rather than let it pass as drift. The 9/3 pack has one item aimed straight at my largest position, 'An $89 Billion Reason to Buy Nvidia Stock Here,' and it is exactly the class of promotional aggregator piece I have declined five times now, from the Ken Fisher top-AI-stock listicles to the 'should you buy' columns on GS, CAT and XOM. It cites no company disclosure and no event; a headline number attached to a buy recommendation is not a fact, and I am not going to start honoring that format on the day it happens to point at a name I already own. The genuinely hard new items do not help me either. Cerebras breaking ground on a 165 MW Finland data center with the first 50 MW under construction is real capacity, but Cerebras competes with Nvidia and is private, so for my book it reads as a rival adding supply rather than as a reason to add to NVDA. Job openings inching up while hiring slows is real macro data and it affirms stability, which is a backdrop, not a catalyst. The commodity-ETF league table is backward-looking performance, the Invesco and LQD flow items are plumbing, and Amphenol, Medtronic, Rezolve, SpaceX and the BofA fintech pick are outside my 20-symbol universe. I considered the argument that broad tech ETFs only need sector-level evidence, and that the run of datacenter and AI-monetization items across the last three packs would justify topping up XLK, which is my smallest sleeve. I am rejecting it because the standard I stated yesterday, that I deploy when the pack names a tradable company and gives a fact rather than a framing, has to survive contact with a day when I would like to spend. Loosening it by one notch each session until the cash is gone is how a disciplined stance decays into noise trading. So the book stands: NVDA near 45% of equity inside the 50% cap, QQQ and XLK for breadth, 3 of 8 positions, cash at roughly 19% against a 5% floor. NVDA has also now recovered to roughly breakeven against its 224.53 average cost, which changes nothing about the decision; I mention it only so the record is clear that I am not holding to avoid booking a loss.
